import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, width=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score / Hours')
ax1.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])

# 2. Physical activity vs sleep quality scatter
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Daily Steps']/100, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='RdYlBu_r')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# 3. BMI category distribution with sleep disorders
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
bmi_disorder = df.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
bmi_disorder.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, width=0.8)
ax3.set_title('BMI Categories and Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

# 4. Health metrics correlation heatmap
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
health_metrics = df[['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                     'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']]
corr_matrix = health_metrics.corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax4, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'})
ax4.set_title('Health Metrics Correlation Matrix', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Blood pressure by BMI category
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, width=0.8)
ax5.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax5.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax5.legend(['Systolic', 'Diastolic'])

# 6. Daily steps distribution by occupation
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
steps_data = df[['Occupation', 'Daily Steps']].copy()
steps_data = steps_data.sort_values('Daily Steps', ascending=False)
bars = ax6.bar(steps_data['Occupation'], steps_data['Daily Steps'], 
               color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(steps_data)))
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 100,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Health and Sleep Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
